literal_TC_contexts.record_kind: Literal TC contexts; BWP-CE identities are a different source population.

projection.kind: Full decision-bearing structured publication projection of the actual model return; not a new receiving episode.
projection.changes: Replaces local absolute path prefixes with logical identifiers; omits redundant source quotations/ephemeral anchor dictionaries from member projections where full source remains bound in the member ledger. Keeps every member outcome, actual decisive reasoning, source/preparation state, applicable owner, missing discriminator, next action and residual. Adds removable allocation metadata without changing identities or values.
projection.hash_subjects: Observed raw receiver bytes and this published projection are distinct objects with distinct hashes. No equality or independent replication is implied.
projection.local_identifier_limit: source-recovery-cache and .IMPLEMENTAUDIT strings are original observation identifiers, not public retrieval claims. Use the exact public source/member/input routes attached to each projected record.
projection.allocation_metadata: Keys beginning __published_identity_ and the explicit bracketed array note are publication context only; remove them to recover the projected data. No frozen state is changed.
